toegepas.voor: Daarom bly die oplossing helder en bevat
toegepas.na: Daarom bly die oplossing helder, en bevat
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('die oplossing bly', 'elke druppel bevat'), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs ('die oplossing bly', 'bevat elke druppel').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two subjects and two verbs, so the AWS 2017 rule calls for the comma, and the meaning does not change.

toegepas.voor: Suiker wat net nog nie opgelos het nie, maak die oplossing nog nie versadig nie.
toegepas.na: Suiker wat net nog nie opgelos het nie, beteken nie dat die oplossing versadig is nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Sugar does not 'make' a solution saturated, and the doubled 'nog nie' reads clumsily; the rewording keeps the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'maak die oplossing nog nie versadig nie' wrongly says the sugar causes saturation, and the doubled 'nog nie' makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The new wording says the same thing (undissolved sugar alone does not show the solution is saturated) without the wrong causal verb, and it reads clearly.

laat_vaar.voor: raak die water later te min om
laat_vaar.na: is daar later te min water om
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Die water raak te min' is unnatural Afrikaans; 'daar is te min water' is the usual expression for the same thing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Te min raak' is natural Afrikaans and says the water becomes too little as it evaporates; the proposal is a lateral move that loses that sense of change.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Met die hand sorteer werk ook nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Om met die hand te sorteer, werk ook nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The bare infinitive phrase as subject reads awkwardly; the 'om te' form is clearer, same words and meaning (leave if 'met die hand sorteer' is a fixed method name in this year).
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Met die hand sorteer' is one of the four named separation methods and reads correctly as a subject, so the longer 'om te' form is a lateral move that also breaks the method name.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Herwin beteken hier terugkry, nie om afval weer te gebruik nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Herwin beteken hier terugkry, nie afval weer gebruik nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The two halves of the contrast are not parallel ('terugkry' vs 'om ... te gebruik'); make both bare infinitives.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The proposal 'nie afval weer gebruik nie' can be misread as a negated clause, so it is harder to read than the clear original.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Ná 'n ruk' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'ná 'n tyd' is a literal rendering.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Ná 'n tyd' is natural Afrikaans, and 'ná 'n ruk' suggests a shorter wait than a salt pan needs, so the change is lateral at best.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Temporal 'soos' follows English 'as'; 'terwyl' is the correct Afrikaans conjunction.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Temporal 'soos' carries the 'namate' sense (the water gets less as it evaporates), and 'terwyl' narrows that to mere simultaneity.
